description: This file contains a comprehensive set of unit tests for the class `DittoDuration` within the package `org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers`. It verifies immutability, null safety, handling of negative and zero durations, string parsing for different time units, string representation, and edge cases of the `DittoDuration` class.

classes.name: DittoDurationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behaviors and correctness of the `DittoDuration` class, including immutability, parsing, string conversion, and edge case handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the `DittoDuration` class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceFromNullDuration
methods.description: Tests that passing null to `DittoDuration.of()` throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceFromNegativeDuration
methods.description: Tests that a negative Duration input throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: getInstanceFromPositiveDuration
methods.description: Tests creating a `DittoDuration` from a positive Duration.

methods.name: getInstanceFromZeroDuration
methods.description: Tests creating a `DittoDuration` from zero Duration.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromString
methods.description: Tests parsing a `DittoDuration` from a string representing a numeric value of seconds.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringSeconds
methods.description: Tests parsing from string with 's' suffix for seconds.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringMinutes
methods.description: Tests parsing from string with 'm' suffix for minutes.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringMilliseconds
methods.description: Tests parsing from string with 'ms' suffix for milliseconds.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringWithAndWithoutSecondsIsEqual
methods.description: Compares durations created with and without specifying 's' suffix to confirm equivalence.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringHoursFails
methods.description: Verifies that parsing hours ('h') throws NumberFormatException.

methods.name: tryToParseEmptyString
methods.description: Tests parsing an empty string throws NumberFormatException.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that `toString()` outputs the correct string representation for different durations.

methods.name: isZeroReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that `isZero()` correctly identifies zero and non-zero durations.

methods.name: parseDurationWithPositivePrefix
methods.description: Tests parsing duration strings with a '+' prefix.

methods.name: tryToParseDurationWithNegativeAmountAndSuffix
methods.description: Verifies that negative durations with suffix throw IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToParseDurationWithNegativeAmountWithoutSuffix
methods.description: Verifies that negative durations without suffix throw IllegalArgumentException.
